Thursday, March 12, 2026

TIDAL WAVE

For Time

5 Rounds:

  • 400m Run
  • 15 Power Cleans (135/95 lbs)
  • 10 Box Jumps (24/20 in)
  • 5 Bar Muscle-Ups

Time Cap: 25 minutes

Beginner modifications

  • Power cleans → 95/65 lbs
  • Box jumps → step-ups
  • Muscle-ups → pull-ups
